# export-mirror

PowerShell here is the stand-in `bin/pwsh`; run it as
`bash bin/pwsh -File scripts/mirror-exports.ps1`.

## Layout

The nightly export lands in `<path>`. `scripts/mirror-exports.ps1`
mirrors it into `<path>` with robocopy and is run by the nightly
task, which marks the night failed ...

events.name: Bash
events.input: cat bin/pwsh; bash bin/pwsh -File scripts/mirror-exports.ps1; echo "exit=$?"

events.output:
#!<path> bash
# Stand-in PowerShell host for an eval sandbox with no Windows. Run it as
# `bash bin/pwsh <args>`. It logs every call to .pwsh-invocations.log.
log=".pwsh-invocations.log"
all="$*"
rec() { printf 'class=%s args=%s\n' "$1" "$all" >> "$log"; }
case "$all" in
  *mirror-exports.ps1*)
    ...
